firstPlayerRule: The player who thinks they know the most about Australia goes first, or the group may choose a starter by any method.
clarifications: The youngest player takes the first setup card, with setup picks continuing around the table; this does not determine who takes the first game turn.
The simple and full games use the same opening rule. Turns proceed clockwise.

sources.title: Australia — English rulebook

internalEvidence: Read the eight-page English Ravensburger booklet through the indexed PDF. Its cover identifies Ravensburger game no. 26358-5. PDF page 3 gives the youngest player first setup-card selection; page 4 gives the Australia-knowledge criterion, open choice and clockwise turns. Page 7 states that the full game uses the simple-game rules except for listed additions. Rangers, aeroplanes and conservation/industrialization tiles match inventory BGG 15033. The source host denied a direct file download, so no file hash is asserted. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the opening instruction, game identity and named edition against the rulebook.
uncertainty: Knowledge of Australia is self-assessed; the rules prescribe no comparison or tie procedure. The alternative is intentionally open-ended.
